# R Script

```{r display-r-code, echo=TRUE}
my_file_name <- 'zzz_output_report02_R_script.R'
my_file_path <- here::here("..", "zzz_zzz_USER_OUPUT_FOLDER", my_file_name)

print(my_file_path)
file.exists(my_file_path)

if (file.exists(my_file_path)) {
  the_code <- readLines(my_file_path, warn = FALSE)
  
  # FORMA CORRECTA:
  the_code
} else {
  cat("File not found:", my_file_path)
}
```
